title: Quickly Optimized
description: Fast Optimization for your potato PC
body:
#### Quickly Optimized 

The Quickly Optimized modpack is designed to deliver the absolute best in Minecraft optimization, featuring carefully selected and finely tuned mods that maximize game performance. Through extensive testing and continuous refinement, it consistently outperforms other optimization packs in benchmarks. When it doesn't, I dive deep to understand why and improve it further.

This pack focuses on maintainability and simplicity, providing a clean base without any quality-of-life or visual enhancements by default — you’re encouraged to customize with your own mods for those features.

If you run into any issues or want to share feedback, feel free to ask me on Bluesky where support and discussion are always welcome!

Thanks to this streamlined approach, the pack quickly integrates the latest performance updates and adapts to new Minecraft versions in record time, keeping your experience fast and fresh.
